title: Implement precise real-time tab switching metrics display for system validation

requirements.summary: Create a detailed real-time metrics display component that shows exact tab switching data including precise switch timestamps (with milliseconds), switch frequency (per minute and per hour), time away durations for each switch, current distraction score with calculation breakdown, and total switches count since session start
acceptanceCriteria: Display shows millisecond-precision timestamps for each tab switch event
Switch frequency metrics update in real-time showing switches per minute and per hour
Each switch event displays the exact duration user was away from the page
Distraction score calculation is visible with the formula breakdown showing how it increments
Total switch count displays cumulative switches since monitoring session began
All metrics update immediately when tab switching occurs without any delay

file_operations.description: Create a new component that displays detailed real-time tab switching metrics. The component will receive switching history data from useFocusMonitor hook and render: (1) a table of the last 20 switch events with millisecond-precision ISO timestamps, away duration in seconds, and distraction score at time of switch; (2) real-time frequency metrics showing switches per minute and per hour calculated from the event history; (3) current distraction score with a breakdown showing the calculation formula (e.g., 'Score = base + (switches × multiplier) + (time_away_factor)'); (4) total switches count since session start. Use shadcn/ui Card, Table, and Badge components for consistent styling. All metrics must update immediately when new switch events occur without delay.

requirements.summary: Update LiveMonitor component in frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx to include a dedicated 'Validation Metrics' section that displays the detailed real-time metrics component with all precise switching data visible simultaneously for system accuracy verification
acceptanceCriteria: LiveMonitor page includes a clearly labeled 'Validation Metrics' or 'Detailed Switching Data' section
Section displays all switching metrics in an easily readable format
Metrics are visible alongside existing monitoring displays
Layout allows for easy comparison between real-time activity and raw switching data

file_operations.description: Modify the LiveMonitor page to import and render the new ValidationMetrics component. Add a new section below the existing real-time monitoring displays with a clear heading 'Validation Metrics' or 'Detailed Switching Data'. Pass the switching history data from useFocusMonitor hook to the ValidationMetrics component. Ensure the layout is organized so that existing monitoring metrics (current app, focus duration, tab switches) remain visible at the top, with the detailed validation metrics displayed below for easy comparison and system accuracy verification.

requirements.summary: Enhance useFocusMonitor hook in frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts to expose a detailed switching history array containing the last 20 switch events with exact timestamps, away duration, and distraction score at time of switch for debugging and validation purposes
acceptanceCriteria: Hook maintains a rolling array of the last 20 switch events
Each event in history includes ISO timestamp with milliseconds, duration away, and distraction score snapshot
History array is accessible to components consuming the hook
History updates immediately when new switches occur

file_operations.description: Enhance the useFocusMonitor hook to maintain a rolling array of the last 20 tab switch events. Add a new state variable 'switchingHistory' that stores an array of objects, each containing: (1) timestamp as ISO string with milliseconds (e.g., using new Date().toISOString()), (2) away duration in milliseconds, and (3) distraction score at the time of the switch. When a new switch event occurs (visibility change or blur event), create a history entry and add it to the array, keeping only the most recent 20 entries using array slicing. Include the switchingHistory array in the hook's return object so components can access it. Ensure the history updates immediately when switches occur. Do not modify the existing core tracking logic that uses Page Visibility API and focus/blur events.
